name: claude-agent-team
description: Scaffolds a complete multi-agent dev team into your project: 7 agents (PM, architect, frontend, backend, QA, reviewer, librarian), an 8-stage serial workflow with human approval gates and change-size tiers (S/M/L), a shared document system (PRD/SPEC/TEST-PLAN/ADR/RUNBOOK/BACKLOG), and an auto-generated STATUS dashboard.
